question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Support
solution:
The correct answer is: **Oppose**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Support **means to endorse, assist, or uphold. (**सहायता**)

 
 
• **Example**: *Friends often provide emotional support during challenging times.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Oppose **means to resist, object to, or be against. (**विरोध**)
 
 
• **Example**: *Some members of the committee decided to oppose the proposed policy changes.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Stay **means to remain in a particular place or condition. (**ठहरना**)
 
• **Bear** means to endure, carry, or support. (**वहन करना**)
 
• **Stand **means to be in an upright position or to take a firm position on an issue. (**खड़ा रहना**)
